verificationRequirements: Verify every metadata identity before using these mappings; pin archive transports against their original manifests.
For one-stream gzip transports: verify each ordered part size/hash, total bytes and concatenated hash before opening the stream; preserve original member path root.
For independent XZ archives: verify each archive separately and map members through the original typed inventory; use original recovery semantics for symlinks, modes and source reconstruction.
Check each known required member against its original manifest identity. Prefix summaries are selectors into unchanged manifests, not a claim every prefix member was consumed.
Rebind historical absolute paths explicitly in a fresh isolated checkout; never overwrite existing closed raw roots or relabel receipts.
Record any unmet external tool/fixture/header/provider prerequisite; do not infer tool availability from archive integrity.
All Phase66 raw files, including malformed JSON and failed outputs, belong in its raw inventory without parsing or success filtering.
